task_description: Add an admin-only way to add/correct past attendance days in EaseMyOffice CRM so the owner can back-fill the current month from WhatsApp login/logout timings before going live with portal attendance on the 12th. Two modes: (1) single-day 'Add / edit attendance' dialog (employee + date + login + optional logout + note), and (2) bulk back-fill grid over a date range writing many employee-days in one submit. All writes go through an admin-gated action in the hr-requests edge function and reuse the existing regularizedAttendance pure helper so an admin-entered day scores IDENTICALLY to a real punch (worked/window/late/status/overtime). Strictly additive and backward-compatible; audited client-side; optional idempotent entry_source migration (owner-applied) marks manual days.
